*Part two drops Tuesday*  — where we test what happens after a full week of real deployment.

*OpenClaw exploded overnight — but there’s a security problem nobody wants to admit.* 
And if you’re deploying autonomous agents inside real systems, this matters more than the hype.

OpenClaw showed the world what AI agents could become: multi-step, autonomous, goal-driven execution. Developers loved it. Communities formed instantly.

But when agents move from demos to production — touching codebases, customer data, internal tools — capability isn’t enough.

Security is.

In this DeepAgent Series breakdown:
• What OpenClaw got right
• The enterprise security gaps most teams are ignoring
• Why autonomous agents are moving into operational workflows now
• What “Secure OpenClaw” actually means in practice
• A walkthrough of Abacus AI Deep Agent running real-world tasks end-to-end
